root_cause_clusters.RC1_WRITE_AFFINITY: Django write routing still honors leftover AZ affinity and can target a standby or demoted node.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_STICKY_READ: Post-write reads are not pinned to the primary for a lag-safe window, so confirmation views observe standby state.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_LAG_GATE: Standby read eligibility uses wall-clock or heartbeat age instead of durable primary/standby LSN watermarks.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_PIN_STORE: Sticky pin and session affinity are stored on a replica-backed session table, so the pin itself can be stale or lost.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_FENCING: Primary fencing is name-based without a monotonic lease epoch, so a demoted node remains writable (split-brain).
root_cause_clusters.RC6_IDEMPOTENCY: Fulfillment/webhook side effects are not keyed by checkout attempt identity across retry and dual-node replay.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_READINESS: Liveness success is treated as traffic readiness, so /readyz stays green during split-brain, lag, or unfenced roles.

defects.observable_failure: AZ-B place-order writes are routed to the standby alias after promotion.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Forcing DATABASES default to the new host still leaves the AZ-B router branch writing replica.

defects.observable_failure: A payment capture UPDATE can execute on a connection that is not the fenced primary.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Retrying failed captures on default hides the affinity bug until the next AZ-B request.

defects.observable_failure: The standby database accepts INSERT/UPDATE instead of failing read-only.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Application try/except fallback to primary masks stray writes instead of fencing them.

defects.observable_failure: Inventory reservation rows can diverge between primary and standby because writes split across aliases.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Re-running apply-standby copies the split but does not stop new split writes.

defects.observable_failure: Immediately after place-order, GET confirmation reads a cart that still looks unpaid.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Routing all reads to primary removes lag bugs but defeats the replica and hides pin-store defects.

defects.observable_failure: A shopper without a recent write is forced onto the primary forever, so lag gating is never exercised.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A permanent primary pin looks consistent but is not a sticky window.

defects.observable_failure: Sticky state is honored only for the same gunicorn AZ that performed the write.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sticky cookies scoped to AZ-A break when the load balancer lands the reload on AZ-B.

defects.observable_failure: Standby is marked read-eligible while applied LSN is behind the primary write LSN of recent orders.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking replica heartbeat age can be fresh while replay has not applied those LSNs.

defects.observable_failure: Lag bytes are computed from row counts rather than primary versus applied watermarks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Equal counts can hide a gap offset by a duplicate standby row.

defects.observable_failure: apply-standby copies fencing lease rows and can resurrect a demoted primary epoch.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping only heartbeat tables still clones lease ownership onto the standby.

defects.observable_failure: Standby apply stops at a hardcoded order id and never catches the incident window.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Raising the cutoff once heals current lag but breaks the next failover window.

defects.observable_failure: Sticky pin stored in Django DB sessions is read from the standby and misses the just-written pin.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing sessions to primary still couples pin durability to database role changes.

defects.observable_failure: Cache alias used for pins shares the replica database wrapper after DATABASES remap.
defects.partial_fix_trap: LocMem cache on one node is not visible to the other AZ gunicorn.

defects.observable_failure: A pin written on AZ-A is invisible to AZ-B because it lives in process-local memory.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sticky cookies without a server store can be stripped or replayed across shoppers.

defects.observable_failure: Old primary remains writable after promote because fencing matches node name without epoch.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Stopping gunicorn on AZ-A hides split-brain until that node is restarted.

defects.observable_failure: Two nodes can both hold writable=true for resource checkout-primary.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Last-writer-wins heartbeat still allows overlapping writable windows.

defects.observable_failure: A stale worker continues writes after a newer lease epoch has been issued.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking owner string fails when the same node id reacquires a new epoch.

defects.observable_failure: Promote-standby flips roles without invalidating the demoted node's write permit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating DATABASES hostnames without fencing leaves both wrappers writable.

defects.observable_failure: Retrying place-order with the same checkout attempt id inserts a second webhook side effect.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deduplicating by order_ref still doubles when the first attempt crashed before order_ref existed.

defects.observable_failure: AZ-A and AZ-B workers both deliver the capture webhook for one attempt.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A distributed lock without a durable attempt key loses the effect if the lock holder dies after send.

defects.observable_failure: Inventory decrement runs twice for one paid attempt after dual-node replay.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clamping quantity at zero hides the double decrement instead of making the effect idempotent.

defects.observable_failure: Side-effect status can be delivered before the order row is committed on the fenced primary.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sending after HTTP 200 still races if the write was on the unfenced standby.

defects.observable_failure: /readyz returns 200 while two writable primaries exist.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking that at least one node is up is liveness, not readiness.

defects.observable_failure: /readyz returns 200 while replica applied LSN is behind the configured lag threshold.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Ignoring replica role entirely makes ready depend only on primary ping.

defects.observable_failure: /healthz and /readyz share the same process-up probe.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Renaming the path without changing the predicate keeps unsafe nodes in rotation.

defects.observable_failure: health.json reports ready true while reconcile.json still lists split-brain or duplicate effects.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing static ready true after a manual failover note does not recompute live invariants.
